findings.claim: All 13 nonempty source-cut intersections survive microsecond rounding; four retained occurrences are unrepresented only at scheduling.
findings.details: Rows 3 and 10 are duplicate source row 5 and lose equal-start ties to rows 2 and 9. Row 4 is the 2 us tiny occurrence; row 8 is the repeated tail. Both contain no sample.

findings.claim: The same clipped source tail is highlighted in cut 0 but not in repeated cut 2 because of sample phase.
findings.details: Row 1 [20000,26667) contains sample 25000. Row 8 [76667,83333) falls between 75000 and 85000. Both source intersections are [90000,100000); rounded durations are 6667 and 6666 us.

findings.claim: Clipping creates an equal destination start for distinct original source starts in the last cut.
findings.details: Source rows 1 and 5 begin at 0, source row 2 at 20000; all clip to 25000 and map to 83333. Retime rows 9 and 10 end at 93333, row 11 at 133333. Original retimed-list position selects row 9 at sample 85000; row 11 resumes at 95000 through 125000. Source timestamps cannot replace that tie rule.

findings.claim: Cumulative exact boundaries differ from summing individually rounded cut durations.
Half-open cuts exclude boundary-only source intersections and preserve the final clamped sample.
findings.details: Source boundary [50000,60000) is absent from cuts 0 and 2, whose starts are 60000. Its cut-3 occurrence [133333,143333) wins samples 135000 and 143332. Last event [13,15) cs ends at 150000 us, 6667 us after the exact integer output duration.

findings.claim: Retain all valid duplicates and original Unicode text; report scheduling loss by occurrence index without changing the fixed policy.
findings.details: Unrepresented source indices are [5,3,4,5] in diagnostic order. Source row 4 has another represented occurrence. The diagnostic is not a list of unique missing transcript words.

limitations: Synthetic bounded fixtures only; no actual audio/video or rendered subtitle assessment.
One midpoint sample per centisecond can miss short words and short pauses, and overlap arbitration can hide long words.
Diagnostics refer to retimed input occurrences, not unique source words. Upstream intersections collapsed by rounding are outside build_events diagnostics; this edit has none.
Grid events may extend by less than 10000 us past media duration; this edit extends 6667 us.
Direct event scan is O(words * ticks); no extreme-size or hostile-subclass guarantee is claimed.
Text is preserved literally; subtitle escaping and format serialization are outside the interface.
No outside adoption, independent review, production acceptance, or rendered-media quality claim.
